subject: RM_CrownVenomvine
departures: grows as one upright, self-standing column taller than a man, not a vine trailing or sprawling over a support
the column is solid black from base to crown, not a green leafy stem
a single flower sits only at the very top of the column, with no blooms along its length
a dense grey cloud of small winged dustflutters swarms around the flowering crown
